title: Software Engineering Manager
description:
**About this role:**


Wells Fargo is seeking a Software Engineering Manager.

 **In this role, you will:**

* Manage, coach, and develop a team of individual contributor engineer roles with low to moderate complexity and less experienced managers who are responsible for building high quality capabilities with modern technology
* Ensure adherence to the Banking Platform Architecture, and meeting non\-functional requirements with each release
* Engage with architects and experienced engineers to incorporate Wells Fargo Technology technical strategies, while understanding next generation domain architecture to enable application migration paths to target architecture; for example, cloud readiness, application modernization and data strategy
* Function as the technical representative for the product during cross\-team collaborative efforts and planning
* Identify and recommend opportunities for driving resolution of technology roadblocks including code, build and deployment while also managing overall software development cycle and security standards
* Act as an escalation partner for scrum masters and the teams to make decisions and help remove impediments, obstacles, and friction while encouraging constant learning, experimentation, and continual improvement culture
* Build engineering skills side\-by\-side in the codebase, conduct peer reviews to evaluate quality and solution alignment to technical direction, and guide design, as needed
* Interpret, develop, and ensure security, stability, and scalability within functions of technology with low to moderate complexity, as well as identify, manage and mitigate technology and enterprise risk
* Collaborate and consult with the Product Managers/Product Owners to drive user satisfaction, influence technology requirements and priorities in the product roadmap, promote innovative and intelligent solutions, generate corporate value and articulate technical strategy while being a solid advocate of agile and DevOps practices
* Interact directly with third party vendors and technology service providers
* Manage allocation of people and financial resources for technology engineering including career development and performance management for engineers and managers on the team
* Hire, mentor and guide talent development of direct reports to build the skills required to effectively design and deliver innovative solutions for the supported product areas/products

 **Required Qualifications:**

* 5\+ years of Software Engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education
* 2\+ years of Leadership experience

**Desired Qualification**

* Strong hands\-on experience with Java and Spring Boot.
* Solid background in system design, microservices, distributed systems, and cloud\-native applications.
* Experience with Kafka, relational/NoSQL databases, Kubernetes/OpenShift, and CI/CD.
* Strong understanding of engineering best practices and production support.
* Proven experience leading and mentoring engineering teams.
* Ability to operate as both a technical leader and people manager.

**Posting End Date:**


27 Sep 2026* ***Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.***

**We Value Equal Opportunity**


Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.


Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance\-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. They are accountable for execution of all applicable risk programs (Credit, Market, Financial Crimes, Operational, Regulatory Compliance), which includes effectively following and adhering to applicable Wells Fargo policies and procedures, appropriately fulfilling risk and compliance obligations, timely and effective escalation and remediation of issues, and making sound risk decisions. There is emphasis on proactive monitoring, governance, risk identification and escalation, as well as making sound risk decisions commensurate with the business unit’s risk appetite and all risk and compliance program requirements.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
**Why Work Here**

* Headquarters is in Charlotte, NC
* Recently expanded to nearshore
* isolved ranked for SMB Payroll in 2023 Sapient Report
* Voted top places to work in USA 2023




**Job Description**

The Manager, Product Engineering for the Suite Experience leads a team of architects and developers focused on modernizing isolved's core HCM user experience by replacing legacy UI patterns with modern, responsive interfaces across its HR, payroll, benefits, and talent products. This role requires a balance of strong people leadership and delivery management, ensuring teams follow effective agile practices through coaching, capacity planning, and accountability for commitments, while also developing talent, addressing skill gaps and performance issues early. Acting as a strategic partner to product management, the manager helps align quarterly commitments with realistic capacity and combines solid technical judgement with leadership expertise in distributed environments to guide architectural decisions, support code quality, remove blockers proactively, use data to assess delivery risks, and translate technical efforts into business value for stakeholders.


**Core Job Duties**

* Drive effective agile execution and continuous improvement by coaching scrum masters and team leads, adapting processes to team needs
* Monitor team health and delivery performance using data, proactively address issues proactively, communicate risks, capacity, and business impact to leadership with transparency and early escalation
* Partner closely with product management on planning and roadmap development, using data to ensure commitments are realistic and aligned with capacity
* Remove blockers proactively, empower teams to resolve issues, and coordinate dependencies across sub\-teams and workstreams
* Developsupport team members through regular 1:1s, targeted coaching, and mentorship to grow technical, leadership, and domain skills, while leading hiring and performance evaluations that foster career development
* Proactively identify and address underperformance using data and observation, following a structured approach to resolution before issues escalate.
* Maintaining technical credibility with the team through engagement in code reviews, architecture discussions, and proof of concept work
* Connecting engineering decisions to business outcomes, explaining tradeoffs between technical excellence and speed to market

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 10\+ years of software development experience
* 4\+ years of engineering management experience, including direct reports and performance management responsibility
* Managing distributed or offshore engineering teams
* Demonstrated experience managing development teams using Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, or hybrid)
* Strong skills in:
* C\#, .NET, Angular, SQL server
* Experience with:
* Azure cloud services
* CI/CD pipelines and deployment practices
* Azure DevOps, Jira, or similar project management tools
* Code review processes and quality standards
* Angular/React
* HCM, HR tech, or enterprise B2B SaaS

Our solutions are delivered directly or through our partner network to more than five million employees and 145,000 employers \- who use them every day to boost performance, increase productivity, and accelerate results while reducing risk. No matter the industry, we help high\-growth organizations employ, enable and empower their workforce by transforming employee experience for a better today and a better tomorrow. For more information, visit www.isolvedhcm.com.

title: AIML Engineer Digital & AI
description:
**Company Description** **ABOUT IQ\-EQ**


We’re a leading Investor Services group offering end\-to\-end services in administration, accounting, reporting, regulatory and compliance needs of the investment sector worldwide. We employ a global workforce of 6,500\+ people across 24 jurisdictions and have assets under administration (AUA) exceeding US$857 billion. We work with 13 of the world’s top\-15 private equity firms.


Our services are underpinned by a Group\-wide commitment to ESG and best\-in\-class technology including a global data platform and innovative proprietary tools supported by in\-house experts.


Above all, what makes us different is our people. Operating as trusted partners to our clients, we deliver intelligent solutions through a combination of technical expertise and strong relationships based on deep client understanding.


We’re driven by our Group purpose, to power people and possibilities.

 **Job Description** **Introduction**


Join our Digital \& AI team as an Engineer, Digital \& AI Solutions, where you will design, develop, and deliver innovative AI\-driven solutions that create business value. You will work with cross\-functional teams to build scalable digital products, leverage emerging technologies, and drive continuous innovation across the organization.

**What you'll do**

* You'll design, develop, and deploy digital and AI solutions, including AI/ML systems, LLMs, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), NLP applications, computer vision systems, predictive analytics, and advanced machine learning models.
* You'll provide technical leadership to developers, data scientists, and engineers, ensuring successful project delivery within scope, budget, quality, and timeline requirements.
* You'll collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements, identify innovation opportunities, and translate complex technical concepts into actionable business solutions.
* You'll establish and maintain best practices for software development, quality assurance, security, scalability, and reliability, utilizing technologies such as Python, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras, transfer learning, LLMs, and AWS Bedrock.
* You'll drive continuous improvement by monitoring solution performance, optimizing processes, ensuring compliance with policies and regulations, and providing technical guidance and thought leadership across the organization.

**What we offer**

* Competitive Total Rewards Package: Comprehensive annual compensation including basic salary, HRA, special allowance, provident fund, gratuity, internet allowance, and food allowance.
* Health \& Insurance Coverage: Medical insurance, group term life insurance, and personal accident insurance.
* Allowances \& Support: Transportation/transport allowance and shift allowance.
* Paid Time Off: Generous leave policy to support work–life balance.

  

**Qualifications** **About you**

* You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field and have at least 2 years of experience delivering AI projects from concept to production.
* You possess strong technical expertise in AI, machine learning, deep learning, reinforcement learning, natural language processing, cloud computing, big data analytics, web and mobile technologies, and IoT.
* You are proficient in Python, Java, or C\+\+ and have hands\-on experience with frameworks and platforms such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit\-learn, Keras, LLMs, transfer learning, and AWS Bedrock.
* You demonstrate excellent communication, problem\-solving, and strategic thinking skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* You are a collaborative team player with strong leadership capabilities and experience working in Agile/Scrum environments; relevant certifications (AWS, Azure AI, etc.) and exposure to global teams, financial services, or private equity environments are advantageous.

  

**Additional Information** **OUR COMMITMENT TO YOU AND THE ENVIRONMENT**


Sustainability is integral to our strategy and operations. Our sustainability depends on us building and maintaining long\-term relationships with all our stakeholders – including our employees, clients, and local communities – while also reducing our impact on our natural environment.


There is always more we can, and should do, to improve – whether in relation to our people, our clients, our planet, or our governance. Our ongoing success as a business depends on our sustainability and agility in a changing and challenging global landscape. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable and diverse culture for our people, led by our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion steering committee.


Our learning and development programmes and systems (including PowerU and MyCampus) enable us to invest in growing our employees’ careers, while our hybrid working approach supports our employees in achieving balance and flexibility while remaining connected to their colleagues. We want to empower our 6,500\+ employees \- from 94 nationalities, across 24 countries \- to each achieve their potential. Through IQ\-EQ Launchpad we support women managers launching their first fund, in an environment where only 15% of all private equity and venture capital firms are gender balanced.


We’re committed to growing relationships with our clients and supporting them in achieving their objectives. We understand that our clients’ sustainability and success lead to our sustainability and success. We’re emotionally invested in our clients right from the beginning.

title: ServiceNow PPM Associate
description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**


At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well\-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80\-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI\-enabled insights and technology\-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**


We are looking for a ServiceNow SPM, PPM, CWM professional with 2–4 years of experience to support the implementation, configuration, and ongoing enhancement of ServiceNow Strategic Portfolio Management, Project Portfolio Management, and Collaborative Work Management capabilities. The candidate should have hands\-on exposure to demand management, project management, portfolio planning, resource management, reporting, and stakeholder coordination within the ServiceNow platform.


Key Responsibilities

* Support configuration and administration of ServiceNow SPM, PPM, and CWM capabilities \- Strategic Portfolio Management, Project Portfolio Management, Collaborative Work Management, including the Intake, Demand, and Capacity management processes, workflows, reporting, and other related functionalities.
* Assist in gathering business requirements from stakeholders and translating them into functional ServiceNow configurations.
* Configure forms, fields, workflows, approvals, notifications, dashboards, and reports based on business needs.
* Support project intake, demand assessment, project tracking, status reporting, resource planning, and portfolio visibility processes.
* Collaborate with functional teams, business users, developers, and platform administrators to deliver scalable ServiceNow solutions.
* Participate in testing activities, including test case preparation, user acceptance testing support, defect tracking, and validation of fixes.
* Maintain documentation for requirements, configurations, process flows, user guides, and support procedures.
* Provide day\-to\-day support for ServiceNow PPM/SPM users, including troubleshooting, issue resolution, and training support.
* Ensure configurations follow ServiceNow best practices, platform governance standards, and maintainability guidelines.

Required Skills and Experience

* 2–4 years of overall experience working with ServiceNow, preferably with exposure to SPM, PPM, CWM related portfolio, project, and capacity planning and management capabilities.
* Hands\-on understanding of ServiceNow platform basics, including tables, forms, lists, workflows, roles, groups, notifications, and reports.
* Working knowledge of PPM/SPM concepts such as demand intake, project lifecycle, portfolio planning, resource planning, financial tracking, and status reporting.
* Basic understanding of Agile, Scrum, waterfall, or hybrid project delivery methodologies.
* Ability to understand business requirements and convert them into clear functional specifications or configuration tasks.
* Experience supporting dashboards, reports, performance analytics, or portfolio\-level visibility is preferred.
* Good analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a team\-oriented environment.

Qualification Requirements

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* Equivalent professional experience in ServiceNow administration, project management systems, or enterprise workflow platforms may be considered.
* Understanding of IT service management, project portfolio management, and enterprise delivery governance is preferred.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to interact with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.

Good to have Certifications or Training

* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification.
* ServiceNow Strategic Portfolio Management / Project Portfolio Management training.
* ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – Strategic Portfolio Management (CIS\-SPM) certification is strongly preferred; candidates who have completed the required learning path or are actively pursuing certification may also be considered.
* Training in ServiceNow SPM Fundamentals and ServiceNow SPM Implementation is preferred.
* Agile/Scrum certification or training, such as Certified Scrum Master (CSM), PMI\-ACP, or SAFe, is an added advantage.
* Project management certification or training, such as PMI \- Certified Associate in Project Management (CAPM), is an added advantage.

Preferred Capabilities

* Exposure to ServiceNow integrations, Flow Designer, basic scripting, or data imports.
* Experience working with project managers, PMO teams, portfolio managers, or delivery governance teams.
* Knowledge of reporting metrics such as project health, demand pipeline, portfolio performance, resource utilization, and milestone tracking.
* Ability to support process improvement initiatives and adoption of standardized project and portfolio management practices.

Good to Have / Rare Skills

* Exposure to ServiceNow Performance Analytics, Advanced Work Assignment, or Predictive Intelligence for portfolio and demand insights.
* Basic knowledge of ServiceNow IntegrationHub, REST/SOAP integrations, MID Server concepts, or external system integrations with tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or Microsoft Project.
* Familiarity with ServiceNow App Engine Studio, custom scoped applications, UI Builder, Workspace configuration, or Now Experience components.
* Understanding of portfolio financial planning, benefit realization tracking, scenario planning, or strategic roadmap management within ServiceNow SPM.
* Awareness of AI\-enabled capabilities in ServiceNow, including Now Assist, automation recommendations, or AI\-driven work prioritization.
  

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

**Our Benefits:**  

At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!

We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!

title: Advanced Software Engr
description:
We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated **Advanced Software Engineer** with 6\-10 years of software application development experience to design, develop, and maintain scalable, high\-performance enterprise IIOT applications. The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise across frontend, backend, gateway integrations, cloud technologies, databases, and event\-driven architectures.


The candidate will work in an Agile environment and actively participate in Scrum ceremonies, sprint planning, estimation, code reviews, and technical solution design while collaborating with cross\-functional teams.


  
**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 6\-10 years of hands\-on experience in software application design and development.
* Strong understanding of object\-oriented programming principles and design patterns.
* Experience building scalable distributed systems and microservices.
* Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and performance optimization skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with IoT platforms and connected device ecosystems.
* Knowledge of containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Familiarity with CI/CD tools and DevOps practices.
* Experience with system monitoring, observability, and logging frameworks.
* Exposure to security best practices for distributed applications.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently and in collaborative Agile teams.
* Strong ownership mindset and commitment to delivering quality solutions.

**Success Criteria**

* Deliver high\-quality, scalable software solutions within sprint timelines.
* Contribute to architectural, design decisions and technical discussions/decisions.
* Ensure application reliability, security, and performance.

Drive engineering excellence through best practices, automation, and code quality standards.


  
**Key Responsibilities**

**Application Design \& Development**

* Design, develop, test, and deploy scalable enterprise\-grade software applications.
* Build responsive and interactive web applications using modern frontend frameworks.
* Develop robust backend services, APIs, and microservices architectures.
* Implement real\-time communication and streaming solutions using WebSockets and messaging platforms.
* Create secure and high\-performing gateway services for device and application integrations.

**Architecture \& Integration**

* Design and implement event\-driven architectures leveraging Kafka.
* Develop MQTT\-based communication layers for IoT and distributed systems.
* Implement RESTful APIs and service integrations using HTTP/HTTPS protocols.
* Work with Protocol Buffers (Protobuf) for efficient data serialization and inter\-service communication.

**Cloud \& DevOps**

* Design and deploy cloud\-native applications on Microsoft Azure.
* Support CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation.
* Monitor application health, performance, and scalability in cloud environments.

**Database \& Performance**

* Design and optimize database schemas and queries.
* Work with relational and time\-series databases.
* Implement caching strategies using Redis.
* Ensure high availability and performance of data services.

**Agile Delivery**

* Participate in Scrum ceremonies, sprint planning, backlog grooming, and retrospectives.
* Provide accurate estimations and technical guidance.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives and engineering best practices.

Mentor junior developers and contribute to technical leadership activities.


**Required Technical Skills**

**Gateway Technologies**

* Strong experience in:
	+ C\#
	+ .NET Framework / .NET Core
	+ MQTT
	+ Protocol Buffers (Protobuf)

**Frontend Development**

* React.js
* JavaScript (ES6\+)
* TypeScript
* WebSocket
* REST APIs / HTTP
* State management libraries and modern frontend development practices

**Backend Development**

* Java
* Spring Framework
* Spring MVC
* Spring REST Services
* Apache Maven
* Embedded Tomcat
* Kafka
* WebSocket
* Protocol Buffers (Protobuf)
* Microservices Architecture

**Database Technologies**

* PostgreSQL
* Redis
* InfluxDB
* Database performance tuning and optimization

**Cloud Technologies**

* Microsoft Azure
* Azure App Services
* Azure Storage
* Azure Monitoring \& Diagnostics
* Azure\-based application deployment and management

  
Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure\-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission\-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

description:

title: Senior Scrum Master
description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------



Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee\-first, performance\-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category\-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. The company specializes in providing solutions across Application Services and Consulting, Digital Product Engineering, Digital Workplace Services, Private Cloud Services, AI/Automation, and ServiceNow. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential.  

  

Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short\-term and long\-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people\-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry\-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.

  

**Job Overview**
----------------



We are seeking a strong Sr. Scrum Master who can help with an organizations SAFe Agile Transformation, supporting global technology and business teams. As an Sr. Scrum Master, you will play a critical role in driving the adoption and implementation of SAFe Agile methodologies across the organization. You will work closely with teams and stakeholders to foster a culture of continuous improvement, collaboration, and high performance. Your expertise will help us accelerate our product development cycles, improve quality, and deliver innovative solutions.


The ideal candidate will be responsible for Product Team motivation and innovation. Must have the ability and experience to push, drive, and motivate the product teams for completing all work according to the business value. Must continuously be two steps ahead of the team, and stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Scrum Facilitation:**

* Guide and coach multiple Scrum teams on the adoption and implementation of Agile/Scrum practices.
* Facilitate all Scrum ceremonies, including daily stand\-ups, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Ensure that Scrum practices are followed, and team members understand and adhere to Agile principles.

**Team Support and Development:**

* Serve as a mentor and coach to Scrum Masters, Product Owners, and team members.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement, encouraging teams to experiment, learn, and adapt their processes.
* Support the development of team members by providing feedback, identifying growth opportunities, and promoting professional development.

**Impediment Removal:**

* Identify and address any impediments that may hinder the team's progress.
* Collaborate with team members and stakeholders to remove obstacles and ensure smooth project execution.
* Escalate issues when necessary to ensure timely resolution.

**Stakeholder Collaboration:**

* Work closely with Product Owners and other stakeholders to ensure alignment on project goals, priorities, and deliverables.
* Facilitate effective communication between the development team and stakeholders.
* Assist in the development and management of product backlogs, ensuring they are well\-groomed and prioritized.

**Process Improvement:**

* Identify and remove impediments that hinder Agile adoption and team productivity.
* Promote a culture of continuous improvement by encouraging teams to experiment, learn, and adapt their processes.
* Ensure teams maintain compliance with pharma regulatory requirements, including GxPwhere applicable.

**Metrics and Reporting:**

* Track and analyze key performance metrics to assess team performance and identify areas for improvement.
* Provide regular reports on team progress, sprint outcomes, and overall project status to stakeholders.
* Utilize data\-driven insights to recommend and implement process improvements.

**Agile Advocacy:**

* Promote Agile principles and practices across the organization.
* Lead training sessions and workshops to educate teams and stakeholders on Agile methodologies.
* Stay up to date with industry trends and emerging Agile practices and introduce new ideas to the organization.

**Ceremonies/Events:**

* Daily Stand\-up
* Backlog Refinement (Grooming)
* Sprint Planning
* Sprint Retrospectives
* Demo's
* UAT's

**Tools**

* Jira / Jira Align
* Smartsheet
* Confluence
* MS Office 365 (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams)
* OneNote
* WebEx
* Miro

 **Qualifications:**

* 8\-12 years of experience working with Agile methodologies, including Scrum, Kanban, and SAFe.
* Demonstrated success as a Scrum Master for newly forming teams, guiding them from startup to maturity.
* Experience working in large\-scale organizations with global, multi\-geographic team structures.
* Proficiency in Agile collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, or Rally.
* Advanced communication and facilitation skills with ability to influence and collaborate across organizational levels.
* Proven ability to manage cross\-functional dependencies and navigate complex stakeholder landscapes.
* Pharma or life sciences experience preferred, particularly in regulated environments (e.g., GxP).
* PI Planning (Quarterly Planning) experience required.
* Agile certifications such as SAFe Certified ScrumMaster (CSM) or equivalent certification are required.
* Familiarity with pharma\-specific projects and product delivery lifecycles.

**Compensation**
----------------

Exact compensation and offers of employment are dependent on circumstances of each case and will be determined based on job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, licenses or certifications, and location.
